bundle.shortDescription: A crew of AI agents that reviews pull requests and answers the reviews on yours
bundle.longDescription: Crewreview runs on your machine with the coding agents you already use. It reviews other people's pull requests and answers the reviews on yours: fixes, replies, resolves and asks for another look. This app keeps the crew running in the menu bar or tray, shows its dashboard and tells you when something waits for your approval.
